intro: One plate of carbonara is about 800 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the pasta and the creamy, cheesy sauce.
diet: Yes, you can, but carbonara is one of the highest-calorie pastas. One plate is like two servings of nasi with lauk. If you're craving it, share it or eat half and add a salad. Keep your other meals that day lighter.
tips: Share one plate with a friend and order a chicken salad for extra protein.
Skip the garlic bread and sweet drinks.
Cooking at home? Use low-fat milk and eggs, and cut down the cream.

swap.name: Prawn aglio olio
swap.why: No cream, so you save about 200 kcal and still get a tasty pasta.

faq.a: The original Italian version uses egg and cheese, no cream. Most cafés in Malaysia add cream to make it creamier.
The original uses pork. Halal cafés usually use chicken, smoked beef or beef bacon. Check the shop's halal status.

faq.q: Why do I feel 'muak' after eating carbonara?
faq.a: The cream and cheese sauce is high in fat, so your stomach feels heavy. Eating it with a salad or a sugar-free drink can help.
